Definition: Elihu, the name of one of Job's friends, and of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elihu = "He is my God"; 1) the younger man who rebuked Job and his three friends; 2) an Ephraimite, Samuel's great grandfather; 3) a Manassite warrior chief for David; 4) son of Shemaiah and Korhite gatekeeper; 5) David's brother
